The plate is square, about 22 cm across in the photo, and spans roughly 400 px, so about 0.055 cm per px.

Scrambled egg whites (or similar) cover about 150x150 px, which is roughly 8x8 cm, or about 50 cm² of footprint. At about 1.5 cm high, that gives about 75 cm³, which I'd put at about 70 g.

The chia pudding covers about 170x200 px, roughly 9x11 cm. It is thin, about 1 cm high, so about 80 g.

The blueberries number about 40 at roughly 2 g each, so about 70 g.

There is a small piece of peach or mango, about 5 g.

Both the egg and the chia pudding are my guesses from how they look.
